bio.text: Mack Jackson was elected to the Georgia House of Representatives on November 4, 2008, and represents House District 128.
He was born and raised in Sandersville, Georgia, and graduated from Georgia College and State University with a degree in Political Science.
He worked for the State of Georgia for 34 years, retiring in March 2006 from the Department of Corrections as a probation officer III, and is the pastor of St. James Christian Fellowship, Inc.
